All implementation is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I implemented in `pkg/definition/ast/transformer.go`:

## Changes

**`hasDisableValidation(field *ast.Field) bool`** (new, package-private)
- Iterates `field.Attrs`, uses `Attribute.Split()` to detect the `@disableValidation()` attribute. Handles nil fields, no attributes, and multiple attributes.

**`EncodeMetadata` / `marshalField`**
- **Idempotency guard**: if the value is already a `*ast.BasicLit` string containing a `// cue-attr:` sentinel, it returns early — no second injection.
- **`@disableValidation()` path**: bypasses structural validation, stringifies the struct to a `*ast.BasicLit`, and prepends each field attribute as a `// cue-attr:@name(args)` comment line (via `marshalFieldDisableValidation` + `buildCueAttrLiteral`). The `seen` map keeps each sentinel unique.

**`DecodeMetadata` / `unmarshalField`**
- When the string value contains `// cue-attr:` sentinels, it skips validation and calls `restoreAttrsFromSentinels`, which rebuilds `f.Attrs` from the embedded lines (deduped, merged with any surviving attrs) — so the count matches the original even after a YAML round-trip that stripped `f.Attrs`.

**`validateStatusField`** (status details)
- Now accepts `*ast.UnaryExpr` field values (requirement 1).
- Handles root-level `*ast.Comprehension` (dynamic string keys with scalar values pass; struct-generated values error with a message containing `<dynamic>`), plus `*ast.EmbedDecl` / `*ast.LetClause` for embedded call-expressions/comprehension args and locally-defined variable embedding.

**`validateCustomStatusField`**
- Added `*ast.UnaryExpr` to accepted message expression types.

Existing tests all pass (`go test`, `go vet` clean), and a temporary test suite covering every listed requirement passed before I removed it. I did not touch anything under `tests/`.

+package ast
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"cuelang.org/go/cue/ast"
+	"cuelang.org/go/cue/parser"
+)
+
+func dumpStruct(t *testing.T, name, input string) {
+	t.Logf("=== %s ===", name)
+	file, err := parser.ParseFile("-", input)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Logf("parse error: %v", err)
+		return
+	}
+	var root *ast.Field
+	for _, d := range file.Decls {
+		if f, ok := d.(*ast.Field); ok { root = f; break }
+	}
+	df, ok := GetFieldByPath(root, "attributes.status.details")
+	if !ok { t.Logf("no details"); return }
+	t.Logf("details.Value type: %T, Attrs=%d", df.Value, len(df.Attrs))
+	for i, a := range df.Attrs {
+		t.Logf("  attr[%d]: %q", i, a.Text)
+	}
+	if sl, ok := df.Value.(*ast.StructLit); ok {
+		for i, e := range sl.Elts {
+			t.Logf("  elt[%d]: %T", i, e)
+			if c, ok := e.(*ast.Comprehension); ok {
+				t.Logf("    comp clauses=%d value=%T", len(c.Clauses), c.Value)
+				if vs, ok := c.Value.(*ast.StructLit); ok {
+					for j, ve := range vs.Elts {
+						if vf, ok := ve.(*ast.Field); ok {
+							t.Logf("    vfield[%d] label=%T value=%T", j, vf.Label, vf.Value)
+						}
+					}
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestExplore(t *testing.T) {
+	dumpStruct(t, "attr", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		foo: "bar"
+	} @disableValidation() }}`)
+	dumpStruct(t, "multiattr", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		foo: "bar"
+	} @disableValidation() @other(x) }}`)
+	dumpStruct(t, "for-scalar", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		for k, v in [{n:"a",val:1}] { "\(k)": v.val }
+	}}}`)
+	dumpStruct(t, "for-struct", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		for k, v in [{n:"a"}] { "\(k)": { inner: v.n } }
+	}}}`)
+	dumpStruct(t, "callcomp", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		result: fn([for x in [1,2] { x }])
+	}}}`)
+	dumpStruct(t, "embedvar", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		let v = context.output
+		v
+	}}}`)
+	dumpStruct(t, "unary", `attributes: { status: { details: {
+		neg: !context.output.status.failed
+	}}}`)
+}
